next_action.description: Read .claude/skills/mpi-node/SKILL.md in c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes plus its CLAUDE.md and existing logic.py / switches.py / if_else.py, then build two nodes: one that saves an H3 AV latent and can block downstream execution, one that loads it and continues. The user rejected a passthrough mode because Mpi Blocker already exists - match existing repo logic first. Both nodes should also output a boolean. Key constraint: the H3 latent is a comfy.nested_tensor.NestedTensor pair (video + audio) and core SaveLatent CRASHES on it.

key_decisions: Ship the PRUNED DiT: 160.0 s vs 162.0 s cold and roughly 2 percent quality delta for +13 GB. See research.md section 6a.

Encoder = ethanfel Qwen3-VL-32B-Ultra-Heretic int8_convrot 26.36 GB, chosen because the complete vision tower stays BF16, which matters for ref2va identity. int4 rejected: ApacheOne's report shows 18-19 percent worst-layer RMSE that also hits the vision tower.
MPI-449 is the UMBRELLA card for the whole H3 arc - no separate card for the engine bump. Sequence: bench research, then MPI-451 licence gate, then engine bump, then MPI-452 wiring.
MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS uses quality mode with 5 tiers, and 1:1 is the short edge of each tier's 16:9 pair (the LTX rule), because ResolutionSelector's own square overshoots H3's 768 short edge.
The MpiNodes staging nodes are GENERIC - they would clean up the WAN workflow too - so they need their own card rather than living under MPI-449.
constraints: NestedTensor exposes ONLY: __add__ __sub__ __mul__ __truediv__ __getitem__ unbind to new_ones float cpu chunk size shape ndim device dtype layout. No contiguous, clone, reshape, mean or std, and NO reflected operators (x*s works, s*x raises).
Core SaveLatent calls samples[samples].contiguous() and therefore CRASHES on an H3 latent; LoadLatent returns a plain tensor, not the pair. unbind() is the way to split video and audio into one file.

Saving the latent alone does NOT enable finish-later: stage 2 also needs the CONDITIONING (Qwen3-VL hidden states plus minimax_keyframes and minimax_frame_count), which safetensors cannot hold. Recommendation was latent-only first.
ExecutionBlocker lives at comfy_execution/graph_utils.py:140 and is handled by the io API - the clean way to block downstream silently.
H3 core nodes are ComfyUI 0.30.0+ with NO backport. The app engine is pinned 0.29.2, so MPI-452 is gated on the bump AND on MPI-451.
H3 is guidance-distilled: use BasicGuider, never SamplerCustom (it forces CFG and demands a negative that the H3 node does not output).
Model shift is 12.0 video / 3.0 audio, applied at model level. Do NOT use ModelSamplingSD3 - use MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, which sets both.
Fine detail is bounded by the /16 latent grid; raising the tier does not fix it. ref2va is the structural answer.
first_frame is plain-stretched to the canvas while last_frame is aspect-preserving, so MPI-452 must fit the source to the canvas aspect.
The bench is port 8188 (v0.30.2); the APP engine is 48188 (v0.29.2). Do not confuse them.
c:/AI/Mpi/ComfyUi-MpiNodes is NOT in permissions.additionalDirectories - writes there may prompt. It is symlinked into the bench at custom_nodes/ComfyUi-MpiNodes.
Timings so far were taken while a Cubric-Prompt agent ran Ollama LLM tests on the same GPU, so they are UPPER BOUNDS.
